access: A Spark or Databricks environment where the agent may run the query against a development checkpoint and target

presentation.name: Design Spark streaming queries that restart without loss or duplicates
presentation.summary: Designs Structured Streaming queries outside declarative pipelines so that restarts, code changes and failures neither skip nor repeat data, and state stays bounded.
benefits: Keeps one checkpoint per query and says which code changes it survives and which need a planned migration
Makes foreachBatch writes idempotent with MERGE or Delta transaction ids, including after a new checkpoint
Chooses available-now, processing-time or real-time triggers, within what serverless supports
Bounds state with watermarks for aggregations, deduplication and stream-stream joins
Sets Kafka and Delta source options so expired or changed data fails loudly instead of disappearing
